_comment: Example real-airport import. Replace with your own locations. Get lat/lng by right-clicking each point in Google Maps (satellite view) and copying the coordinates. POST this to /api/locations/import as admin, or paste it into Admin → Locations → Import. Existing codes are updated in place; the map projection is refitted to your airport automatically when all locations carry lat/lng.
_templates_comment: Optional rough walking-time seeds in minutes (wheelchair pace). both_ways defaults to true (seeds A->B and B->A). You only need the main routes — the system replaces these with the median of real completed tasks after 5 samples per route.
